property_summary: For any account that has never received an airdrop (tokenBalance == 0) and satisfies the token-signature check, airDrop must succeed and set that account's balance to exactly 20; the mutant requires a pre-existing balance of 1 and therefore reverts for every fresh account.
change_summary: Require an existing balance of 1 instead of 0, so airdrops always revert for fresh accounts.
